source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: A daily document-processing skill succeeds in a manual trial. You want it to run unattended. Which preparation best addresses the added demands?

options.text: Define triggers, saved progress, checks, and stopping rules
options.feedback: Also establish required inputs, allowed actions, missing-access behavior, and an available host. Test failure cases before relying on repeated runs.

options.text: Rely on the single success and repeat the same command continuously
options.feedback: A successful trial leaves failure behavior and repeated-run effects untested. Persistent operation needs explicit operating conditions.

options.text: Keep the host online and let each run start without knowledge of prior work
options.feedback: Availability is necessary, but saved progress helps later runs resume without duplicating changes.

options.text: Create a daily trigger and assume missing inputs will resolve themselves
options.feedback: A trigger schedules work but does not define what to do when inputs or access are absent. Specify failure and stopping behavior.
